title: Core Banking Consultant
summary: Core banking consultants set up and roll out a bank's core banking system (the software that runs accounts, deposits and loans), such as Finacle, Temenos Transact or Oracle FLEXCUBE. They sit between bank business teams and technical developers, configuring products, writing specs, testing and moving data during implementations and upgrades.
dailyDuties: Run requirement workshops with bank operations teams
Set up and parameterise CASA, deposit and loan products
Write functional specs and gap analyses for customisations
Prepare test scenarios and support SIT and UAT cycles
Map and reconcile data during migration from the old system
Analyse interface specs for channels and payment systems
Log and follow up defects with the technical team

skills.expectation: Work hands-on in a core banking system such as Finacle or Oracle FLEXCUBE
Set up and parameterise CASA, deposit and loan products, interest and GL mapping
Know retail banking products and operations: CASA, term deposits, loans and the general ledger
Run workshops with the bank and write functional specs and gap analyses
Prepare test scenarios and support SIT and UAT cycles through go-live
Query the core banking database to validate data and investigate defects
Map, load and reconcile data from the old system during migration or upgrade
Work with bank business users, IT teams and the vendor to agree scope and sign-off
Present solution designs and test results clearly to bank teams
Read API and interface specs for channels, payments and other connected systems
Write SIT test cases and log defects
Read or write PL/SQL and platform scripts for customisations and reports
Understand branch and back-office banking operations from experience

certifications.why: Shows structured business analysis practice for requirements and gap analysis work
